item.text: The PNG copy exists and the required tools are installed. I’m now writing the receipt from the copied file and will verify both outputs exist afterward.

item.command:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "set -euo pipefail
png='/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills-main/skills/persona-dream/reports/goal_v3/cycles/horus_full_01/frames/sb_003.attempt_01.png'
receipt='/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills-main/skills/persona-dream/reports/goal_v3/cycles/horus_full_01/frames/sb_003.attempt_01_scillm_image_generation_receipt.json'
sha="'$(sha256sum "$png" | awk '"'{print "'$1}'"')
dims="'$(identify -format '"'%w %h' \""'$png")
width=${dims%% *}
height=${dims##* }
jq -n --arg path "$png" --arg sha256 "$sha" --arg auth '"'codex_oauth_image_gen' --argjson width \""'$width" --argjson height "$height" '"'{ok:true,auth:"'$auth,path:$path,width:$width,height:$height,sha256:$sha256}'"' > \""'$receipt"
test -s "$png"
test -s "$receipt"
jq -e '"'.ok == true and .auth == \"codex_oauth_image_gen\" and .path == "'$path and (.width|type)=="number" and (.height|type)=="number" and (.sha256|test("''^[0-9a-f]{64}$"))'"' --arg path \""'$png" "$receipt" >/dev/null
ls -l "$png" "$receipt"
cat "$receipt"'
